decision.thesis: Account flat, nothing to reconcile. For the FIRST TIME IN THE EXPERIMENT THE EVIDENCE GATE IS MET - `trend` and `price_action` are both independently claimable for a short - AND THE TRADE IS STILL REFUSED, on geometry and on the book. That is the finding of this check: the gate was never the binding constraint. XRPUSDT excluded (09-23 04:00Z 4h bar 4.191% wick on a 0.124% body = 33.9x, unrevised). ETHUSDT is the ONLY readable contract for a second consecutive check, and its three 1h flags were each cleared by cross-contract comparison: the 09-23 14:00Z bar is a market-wide selloff (BTC 1.987%, BNB 2.798% at the same bar), and the 09-24 05:00Z upper wick (0.536%) is matched by SOL 0.537% and XRP 0.807% at the identical candle - real rejections, not artifacts. L-002 REFUSES BOTH DIRECTIONS AND THE MAGNET CLAUSE IS DECISIVE: N stated four ways - 0.205% (full preceding hour, 12:00Z bar), 0.294% (2h window, 10:50Z bounce-impulse bar), 0.551% (window containing the 09:30Z selloff bar that CREATED the 2633.31 low every short targets) - the honest binding measurement is 0.551%. The short's structurally honest stop 2651.20 is 0.83x N(hour), 0.58x N(2h) and 0.31x N(honest) at the final quote - SUB-NOISE on every reading - and it sits 0.09% above 2650.63, A LEVEL TOUCHED SEVEN TIMES (09:35Z and six consecutive bars 11:00Z-11:25Z), which is the magnet clause verbatim. The long's stop 2632.80 below the 24h low is 0.96x N(honest), also sub-noise. L-003 PRODUCES THE STRONGEST PATHOLOGICAL INSTANCE OF THE EXPERIMENT, A 13TH CONSECUTIVE MATERIAL CHECK: the short's net RR to 2633.31 ran 0.563 -> 0.819 -> 0.912 -> 0.843 -> 2.152 across 284 seconds, A 3.8x INFLATION THAT CROSSED THE 1.5 FLOOR - and every bit of it came from the bid drifting 2642.12 -> 2646.70 TOWARD the fixed stop, shrinking risk 0.344% -> 0.170% while growing reward, BOTH HALVES IMPROVING FROM ONE CAUSE. At that same instant the stop fell from 1.68x to 0.83x N(hour): IT CROSSED THE FLOOR AT THE EXACT MOMENT IT STOPPED BEING A STOP, and the same move reclaiming 2642.12 -> 2646.84 is what breaks the failed-bounce premise the short rests on. Clock stays ZERO. L-004 RUN FIRST REFUSES EVERYTHING: against the honest N the required span is 1.5175% and the short's nearest-target span is 0.303% (FAIL by 1.215pp), 0.422% to 2640.06 (FAIL by 1.096pp) and 0.679% even to the 24h low (FAIL by 0.838pp); the long's nearest-target span is 0.577% (FAIL by 0.941pp). Only two constructions pass any span test and only against the FLATTERED hour window. TARGET VALIDITY INDEPENDENTLY KILLS THE ONLY CONSTRUCTION THAT CLEARS 1.5: the short's 2633.31 jumps FIVE intervening supports - 2643.20 (12 touches), 2642.56 (11), 2640.06 (8), 2637.86 (6), 2635.87 (3) - to reach a level TOUCHED EXACTLY ONCE, a single-print low that is the thinnest level on the board and the only one the arithmetic works against. L-005 REFUSES BOTH INDEPENDENTLY OF ALL GEOMETRY, A 12TH CONSECUTIVE CHECK, AND ETHUSDT COLLAPSED TWICE INSIDE ONE CHECK - A NEW FORM: five sweeps in 284 seconds gave ETH bid 1,236,964 -> 66 -> 1,074,488 -> 7,218,896 -> 108 USDT, i.e. the side BOTH trades must cross went to DOUBLE DIGITS TWICE, at 0.87 bps and 0.529 bps; a maximum 2,500 USDT market sell is 38x and 23x the entire visible bid. The short sells into that bid, the long exits into it, and the long's reduce-only stop RESTS on it between checks. BNBUSDT printed an 8 USDT ask, SOLUSDT an 84 USDT ask and a 362 USDT bid, XRPUSDT a 19 USDT bid. NO CONTRACT BREACHED THE 25 bps CAP - the widest spread all check was 10.595 bps - a 12TH CONSECUTIVE CHECK IN WHICH THE CAP WAS BLIND TO THE ENTIRE FINDING. L-006 applied to every window-derived figure: BNB's artifact leaving the 5m window and the 24h high field is the predicted flicker and is refused as evidence of recovery; recorded AGAINST INTEREST that the 24h relative figures were STABLE this check (0.012pp-0.088pp over five minutes) unlike the 0.305pp four-minute move at 16:00, which is a factual record and changes nothing. Funding is clamped a 13TH consecutive check and for the first time ALL FOUR non-zero rates sit EXACTLY at the +0.010000% cap (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP) with BNB exactly 0.000000% - XRP's -0.004380%, the only unclamped rate at 16:00, has pinned too. Next funding 16:00Z = 00:00 local, confirming the 16:00 note's correction: the 00:00 check sits on the settlement, not this one. news RECORDED NOT CLAIMED AS A REASON NOT TO TRADE: the Trump-Xi summit is in Washington TODAY, the selloff is externally confirmed as a Treasury-yield shock (10y +15bp to 5.11%, BTC ~83,200 externally against 83,388 on the demo host - the demo price is NOT the artifact here), and the reported set-up is explicitly binary.
